strong_verification.donation_message1: Verification is free for you, but it does come at a cost to us. As a nonprofit run by volunteers, we rely on donations to cover expenses like keeping our servers running, verification, and tools for volunteers and community builders.
strong_verification.donation_message2: If you're able, please consider donating to help keep Couchers.org running and growing.

instructions.title: How to Complete Strong Verification
instructions.warning: Important: The passport chip scanning step can be tricky—read all instructions first!
instructions.step1_apple_note: Apple users: You can skip the download and use your browser instead. Just click "Open" when prompted.
instructions.step2: Click "Start Strong Verification" below (opens in new tab)
instructions.step3: Scan the QR code with your phone
instructions.step4: If prompted, open the app and scan the QR code again
instructions.step6: Take a clear photo of the passport page with numbers at the bottom
instructions.step7: Hold your phone against the passport page with the NFC chip (see tips below)
instructions.step8: You'll know it's successful when you see increasing percentages and a loader

chip_location.heading: Finding Your Passport's NFC Chip
